name: kaal
description: KAAL: a first-person atmospheric horror game. A family dinner, a power cut, and a match that brings back 1987 for as long as it burns.

scripts.check: for f in server.mjs shared/*.js src/*.js src/*/*.js test/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.package: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && zip -rq dist/kaal-web.zip index.html src shared assets -x '*.DS_Store' && echo dist/kaal-web.zip
